title: Nutty Smoky Korean Rice Tteok
description: A smoky and adventurous Korean dish featuring stout and coconut cream, with a bouncy qq texture and anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients, formed into tteok
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the Korean rice flour, smoked paprika, turmeric, and salt, and whisk to combine
In a separate bowl, whisk together the stout beer, coconut cream, and sesame oil
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir to form a dough
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic
Cover the dough with plastic wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a small ball
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and cook in a non-stick pan over medium heat for 3-4 minutes per side
Garnish with chopped nuts and grated ginger, and serve warm
